item.title: Do Messages Deliver When Phone Is Dead or Off?
item.description: What to Know If your iMessage doesn't say Delivered it could mean that the recipient’s phone is off or out of battery. If the recipient has other Apple devices set up to receive messages, it might say Delivered because it was delivered to their Apple Watch, iPad, or Mac. An ‘iPhone message not delivered’ issue can mean several things, including that the recipient’s phone is simply off or out of battery.
